cover.title: STATEMENT OF WORK — ATTACHMENT A
cover.subtitle: Scope of Services: CrowdStrike — Matillion Migration (ACV Domain)
cover.note: This Attachment is incorporated into and governed by the Order Form and the Master Services Agreement (or equivalent governing agreement) between the parties. Capitalized terms not defined herein have the meanings given in the governing agreement. This is a fixed-price, fixed-outcome engagement based on the scope defined below.

blocks.text: CrowdStrike's Annual Contract Value (“ACV”) reporting depends on Matillion pipelines that load and transform data in Snowflake. The current design relies on full-scan soft-delete processing, embedded Python, and a multi-step Matillion orchestration chain, adding tooling cost, operational complexity, and a dependency outside the Snowflake platform. CrowdStrike wishes to retire Matillion, where possible, from the ELT process.

Over a sixteen (16) week fixed-fee engagement, Snowflake Professional Services will migrate the ACV domain to a Snowflake-native dbt + Airflow/Streams + Tasks architecture and retire Matillion for data pipelines in Snowflake. Snowflake will validate financial parity before a de-risked, parallel-run cutover, and will then enable CrowdStrike to operate and extend the pattern independently. Snowflake is responsible for ensuring production-grade quality of the solution.
The engagement is measured against the following objectives and their associated success criteria:

items.text: Matillion is retired from the ACV workflow; all outputs are produced natively within Snowflake.
Row counts, checksums, and ACV figures match the legacy outputs, confirmed by CrowdStrike.
The Streams-based incremental pipeline runs reliably within fifteen (15) minutes.
dbt tests pass on each run; the monthly close is locked via a Snowflake Task and stored procedure.
Parallel-run parity is achieved with zero disruption to the monthly close.
CrowdStrike operates the solution independently, with a clear path to the next domain (e.g., ARR).

blocks.text: The scope of services is organized into five (5) phases and their constituent workstreams. Activities within each workstream are set forth below. Estimated timelines are relative to the confirmed Kickoff (Week 1).

rows:
• Establish communication channels and define project frameworks
• Complete internal handoffs and resource coordination
• Conduct kickoff session; confirm goals, timelines, and success criteria
• Request and validate access to Snowflake, Matillion, Git repos, and other systems
• Provision Snowflake dev schemas; scaffold dbt project; configure dbt-Snowflake connection; set up CI/CD pipeline skeleton

• Walk through all ACV Matillion jobs and catalog each pipeline inventory object (type, sources, targets, schedule)
• Identify all pipeline object dependencies and lineage
• Review each embedded script and categorize between SQL, Python, and other custom jobs
• Capture row counts, checksums, and SLAs for all ACV domain output tables
• Produce target architecture design with dbt model layers
• Finalize pipeline toolset decision using Snowflake dbt projects + Tasks

• Convert the 10 Matillion staging table load jobs into dbt source + staging models
• Replace the soft-delete flag full-scan processes with Snowflake Streams on raw SF/CPQ tables
• Add dbt tests to all staging models

• Convert CPQ/GenX union logic into dbt intermediate models
• Convert each ACV calculation method into a dbt model and consolidate into mart-layer output
• Replace the 5 embedded Python scripts with dbt SQL models, Snowflake Tasks, or Snowpark UDFs per design decision
• Add dbt tests for ACV calculation correctness and custom financial logic

• Implement dbt SCD2 snapshot for Product dimension
• Implement dbt SCD2 snapshot for Account dimension
• Convert ACV fact table load into dbt model
• Implement monthly close lock using Snowflake Task + stored procedure

• Configure DAG orchestration replacing the Matillion 3-step chain using Airflow or Tasks per design decision
• Configure the 15-minute incremental schedule, retry logic, and Slack/email alerting
• Set up parallel-run configuration for testing

• Run new pipeline in parallel with Matillion and compare cycle results
• Parity check on row count, checksum, and other key metrics across all ACV output tables
• ACV metric validation with CrowdStrike to confirm financial figures match Matillion outputs
• Confirm pipeline execution and data freshness under the 15-min incremental SLA

• Validate ACV outputs against existing records and resolve issues
• Monitor first 3 incremental cycles of the new pipeline
• Support the Matillion ACV jobs migration and cutover

• Provide architecture documentation, dbt model lineage, orchestration design, ACV data dictionary, and operational runbooks
• Up to 3 knowledge-transfer sessions covering the new pipeline
• Discuss how to scale and extend to the next data domain (e.g., ARR)

blocks.text: Snowflake will produce the following deliverables. Deliverables are subject to the acceptance process defined in Section 6.

rows: Kickoff Deck; Access Checklist; dbt Project Scaffold & CI/CD Skeleton
Kickoff alignment, validated system access, and an initialized dbt project with CI/CD skeleton.
Pipeline Inventory Spreadsheet; Script Classification Log; Baseline QA Report; Data Architecture Diagram
Catalog of every Matillion ACV job, script classification, baseline of current outputs, and target dbt architecture.
dbt Staging Models; Snowflake Streams CDC
Refactored staging layer with Streams-based CDC replacing soft-delete full scans.
dbt Intermediate Models; dbt ACV Mart Models
ACV calculation logic and CPQ/GenX union rebuilt as dbt intermediate and mart-layer models.
dbt Snapshot Models (Dimensions & Facts); Monthly Close Lock Solution
SCD2 Product/Account dimensions, ACV fact load, and a monthly close lock (Task + stored procedure).
Orchestration DAG Config; Alert & Notification Setup
DAG orchestration, 15-minute incremental schedule, retry logic, and Slack/email alerting.
Parallel-run parity results across all ACV output tables, with formal testing sign-off.
Documented UAT validation of ACV outputs and resolution of issues.
Solution Documentation & Runbook; KT Session Recordings
Architecture docs, dbt lineage, ACV data dictionary, runbooks, and up to 3 recorded KT sessions.
